Compact Utility Performance with Easy Operation

Built to Work. Engineered for Simplicity and Control.

The CK2620HB is designed for ease of operation with hydrostatic drive, smooth forward/reverse pedal control, and strong loader capability for its class. It is a practical choice for users who need dependable lifting, digging, and mowing performance in a compact footprint.

Features May Include:

Diesel Engine Efficiency
Fuel-efficient 24.5 HP KIOTI diesel engine designed for dependable daily operation and low noise.

Hydrostatic Transmission (HST)
Infinitely variable speed control with pedal-driven forward and reverse operation for easy maneuvering.

4WD Capability
Four-wheel drive provides traction in mud, snow, and uneven terrain.

Loader-Ready Design
Compatible with front-end loaders for material handling and property maintenance tasks.

High Ground Clearance
Designed to navigate uneven terrain and light off-road conditions with stability.

Category 1 3-Point Hitch
Supports a wide range of compact tractor implements including blades, mowers, and tillers.

Operator-Friendly Controls
Power steering, simple pedal layout, and ergonomic station design for ease of use.
